d: Long, wavy platinum blonde hair with a side part and voluminous curls cascades down the back. The eyes are a sharp, piercing blue with a confident, narrow gaze. The face reflects a mature, sophisticated adult with a slender, elegant build. The outfit consists of a floor-length, form-fitting dark charcoal grey dress featuring black lace paneling and a low-cut neckline, paired with a vibrant crimson red jacket draped over the shoulders and a royal blue scarf tied around the neck. Accessories include a black rectangular clutch with white cursive writing, gold bracelets on the wrist, and pointed black high-heel pumps.
